concerns.text: Plan's Complexity Tracking and Constitution III mandate a materialized 'Fixed Representative Subset' (data-model.md: 'subset_train.parquet' as a new file with recorded checksum), but no task creates or materializes this subset file. T006 only references *reducing* it if the budget is exceeded. An implementer following the plan/data-model cannot produce the subset artifact.

FR-005 requires grid-search model selection 'then evaluate on the held-out validation set' (US-2 acceptance 3). T005 evaluates only the training set (train_metrics.json) and held-out test set (test_metrics.json); no task computes validation-set R²/RMSE/MAE as the model-selection evaluation FR-005 mandates. T009 uses the validation split only for SC-003 interpretability.

T001 writes the schema to 'specs/001-assess-ml-predictive-power/contracts/output.schema.yaml', but the actual feature directory is 'specs/001-assessing-the-predictive-power-of-machin/'. The path mismatch will make the verification command ('cat specs/001-assess-ml-predictive-power/...') fail even when the artifact exists.
